question: How many tracks have no composer listed?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Composer IS NULL

question: What is the largest single invoice total?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(Total) FROM Invoice

question: How many employees were hired in 2003?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee WHERE strftime('%Y', HireDate) = '2003'

question: How many tracks are longer than 10 minutes?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 600000

question: How much revenue did invoices bring in during the first quarter of 2011?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2011-01-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2011-04-01'

question: How many tracks are on the album 'Let There Be Rock'?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId WHERE al.Title = 'Let There Be Rock'

question: Which genre has the longest average track duration?
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY AVG(t.Milliseconds) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the total revenue from customers in Germany?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'Germany'

question: Which countries have more than 3 customers?
gold_sql: SELECT Country FROM Customer GROUP BY Country HAVING COUNT(*) > 3

question: Who is the youngest employee?
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee ORDER BY BirthDate DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FirstName || ' ' || LastName FROM Employee ORDER BY BirthDate DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which composer has the most tracks in the catalogue?
gold_sql: SELECT Composer FROM Track WHERE Composer IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Composer ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many artists have no albums in the catalogue?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Artist ar WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Album al WHERE al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId)

question: What is the average number of tracks per invoice?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(n), 2) FROM (SELECT InvoiceId, SUM(Quantity) AS n FROM InvoiceLine GROUP BY InvoiceId)

question: Customers from which country bought the most Rock tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT c.Country FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock' GROUP BY c.Country ORDER BY SUM(il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers have spent more than the average customer?
gold_sql: WITH spend AS (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS s FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spend WHERE s > (SELECT AVG(s) FROM spend)

question: Which support representative has customers in the most different countries?
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT c.Country) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT c.Country) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which album has generated the most revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY al.AlbumId ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which employees have nobody reporting to them?
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Employee r WHERE r.ReportsTo = e.EmployeeId)
SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName FROM Employee e WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Employee r WHERE r.ReportsTo = e.EmployeeId)

question: In which year did customers from Brazil spend the most?
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', i.InvoiceDate) FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'Brazil' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the total quantity of Iron Maiden tracks sold?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(il.Quantity) FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId WHERE ar.Name = 'Iron Maiden'
